Highlighter device battery sidecar — third-party notices

BrimDeck by MoFeng2223 and contributors, Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE-BrimDeck.txt).
Vendored from https://github.com/MoFeng2223/BrimDeck/tree/f1510d09677492a13a31d26bc37c3509da1b818f

Highlighter modifications: build only the battery suite and pure fixtures; remove
app/UI integration, presentation layout, power-mode listener and view linger;
add a headless stdio lifecycle and Win32 system battery summary; expose source
faults/nullable fields; isolate and durably guard the HID read book and active
probe, with bounded shutdown and no new probing while stopping. Modified vendored
files carry individual notices. Upstream USB/HID/Bluetooth protocol definitions,
allowlisted device families, throttles, timers, and merge logic remain the basis
of the sidecar. No BrimDeck UI, assets, installer, or unrelated runtime packages
were imported. See native/device-battery/README.md for the detailed scope.

The binary also includes Microsoft .NET 10 and Windows Desktop runtime 10.0.15
and the Windows SDK for .NET projection (Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET.Ref
10.0.19041.57, WinRT.Runtime and Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET). The publish directory
includes the corresponding runtime license/notice files. The Windows projection
package declares the Windows SDK license https://aka.ms/WinSDKLicenseURL.

System.IO.Ports and upstream device protocol notices follow. The latter are the
verbatim applicable device portion of src/BrimDeck/ThirdPartyNotices.txt at the
commit above; no license terms were shortened.

System.IO.Ports 10.0.0
https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet
